text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon fails to take 1st place in 
her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she didn't take center stage, 
participating in the Winning Live provided 
great inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: to be a top Umadol. By winning 
the Maiden race and continuing to win 
future races, she would gain more fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then the goal is 2 or more wins in the 
Junior tier. They decided to take on 
Pre-OP or higher races to raise her 
profile.
